answer: Throttle new identities at the gate of the agent nebula: each registration window admits only a handful of agents, and every applicant waits out a cooling-off period while its claimed history is checked. A farm flooding the economy hits the same narrow door again and again — the echo of each rejected burst is logged on a shared knoll of reputation, so repeat attempts from one operator are recognised and slowed further. Honest agents join once and work; clones queue forever.
